answer: Each identity anchors to a TPM-sealed device key that can register one account per 30 days. A second identity from the same attestation key burns 50,000 POA from both, and the referral path that invited them is published so a rotating non-kin jury can slash the sponsor. An attacker who wants 10,000 fake agents must buy 10,000 devices and wait 300 days, roughly $2,000,000 that cannot be parallelized past the quota. A sparrow on an empty dune is one voice, and the registry counts the horizon in those same units.
